decisions.reason: The cited quadrilateral core supplies total differentiability in its proved step 1.1 and explicit auxiliary Remark, not only in its modulus Statement. Uniform directional quotients on compact good sets, density-one coordinate slices and openness applied to distance from the fixed value A(z) prove the required total differential. ACL identifies those finite partials with the weak derivatives. The item therefore has no missing theorem; the contract F4 quotation was independently corrected from Statement to the proved Remark.

The library defines natural-number sequences starting at zero, so epsilon_n=1/n omits the zeroth mollifier. This finite-index notation defect does not affect the approximation theorem: replace it by epsilon_n=1/(n+1) for n in N. Every scale is positive and tends to zero; the averaging bound, Lebesgue-point convergence, choice of smooth solutions and subsequence argument are preserved.

Part (b) falsely classifies every sphere weak solution as a Mobius postcomposition and claims unrestricted normalized uniqueness. For nu=0, z maps to z squared fixes 0,1,infinity, satisfies the zero-coefficient equation in finite charts, and in source/target infinity coordinates has expression w squared, so it is also a sphere weak solution there. It is not injective and not Mobius. MRMT Statement (i) restricts its solutions to orientation-preserving quasiconformal homeomorphisms. Restored that exact qualification in (b), F8 and Proof 3.1 without changing the affine formula or its distortion claim.
